q.en: "Government programmes aim to ___ the digital divide."
q.bn: "Government programmes aim to ___ the digital divide."

why.en: "Bridge the digital divide" is the fixed collocation meaning to reduce the gap in technology access.
why.bn: "Bridge the digital divide" fixed collocation, মানে technology access-এর gap কমানো।

q.en: "The factory ___ its entire assembly line last year."
q.bn: "The factory ___ its entire assembly line last year."

why.en: "Automated" is the past simple of the verb "automate", needed here because of "last year".
why.bn: "Automated" হলো verb "automate"-এর past simple, "last year"-এর কারণে এটাই লাগবে।

q.en: "A sharp rise in ___" refers to online crimes like hacking and fraud.
q.bn: "A sharp rise in ___" online crime যেমন hacking এবং fraud বোঝায়।

why.en: "A rise in cybercrime" is the standard collocation referring to online crimes in general.
why.bn: "A rise in cybercrime" standard collocation, সাধারণভাবে online crime বোঝায়।

q.en: Which pair contrasts in-person interaction with interaction through a screen?
q.bn: কোন pair সামনাসামনি interaction আর স্ক্রিনের মাধ্যমে interaction-এর মধ্যে contrast দেখায়?

why.en: "Face-to-face" means in-person interaction; "virtual communication" means interaction through a screen.
why.bn: "Face-to-face" মানে সামনাসামনি interaction; "virtual communication" মানে স্ক্রিনের মাধ্যমে interaction।

q.en: In an essay about AI, which pair correctly represents its double-edged nature?
q.bn: AI নিয়ে essay-তে কোন pair এর double-edged nature সঠিকভাবে বোঝায়?

why.en: AI essays typically weigh a benefit like boosted productivity against a risk like job displacement.
why.bn: AI নিয়ে essay-তে সাধারণত boosted productivity-র মতো benefit-এর সাথে job displacement-এর মতো risk তুলনা করা হয়।
